description: CoreXY calibration. Homes Y against the Y-min switch first to establish the Y origin, parks the gantry a short distance clear of that switch, then probes X min and X max and measures X steps per centimetre from the entered track length. A limit switch already pressed at the start is nudged clear rather than treated as an error.

inputs.label: Selected ESP32
inputs.description: Connected ESP32 board that should run the X calibration routine.

inputs.label: X Track Length (cm)
inputs.description: Physical X travel in cm between the X-min and X-max limit switches.

inputs.label: Y Track Length (cm)
inputs.description: Physical Y travel in cm from the Y-min switch to the far end. Y is homed against the Y-min switch, which defines Y = 0; this value sets the Y track length used to bound later moves.

inputs.label: X Calibration Y (cm)
inputs.description: Y position the gantry parks at, clear of the Y-min switch, while X is calibrated. Sweeping X while the carriage still rests on the Y switch loads the frame against its stop. Y is corrected onto this exact value once X measures the true steps per cm.

inputs.label: Limit Buffer (cm)
inputs.description: Safety gap kept between the usable workspace and every limit switch. User coordinate 0 sits this far off the min switch and the usable max is the track length minus one buffer at each end, so moves to 0 or to the max stop short of the switches instead of tripping them. Changing it re-derives the ranges on the move blocks.

inputs.label: Calibration Speed (RPM)
inputs.description: Numeric motor speed used while probing X limits.

inputs.label: Trapezoidal Speed
inputs.description: Enable acceleration and deceleration ramping instead of jumping directly to target speed.

inputs.label: Acceleration (RPM/s)
inputs.description: Acceleration and deceleration rate used for trapezoidal speed ramping.

inputs.label: Steps per Rotation
inputs.description: Stepper pulse count for one full motor rotation. Use 800 when the driver is configured for 800 steps per rotation.

inputs.label: Max Probe Rotations
inputs.description: Maximum motor rotations allowed for each X limit-switch probe before calibration stops with a safety error.

advanced_inputs.label: CoreXY A Step Pin
advanced_inputs.description: Runtime GPIO step pin for the CoreXY A driver.

advanced_inputs.label: CoreXY A Dir Pin
advanced_inputs.description: Runtime GPIO direction pin for the CoreXY A driver.

advanced_inputs.label: CoreXY B Step Pin
advanced_inputs.description: Runtime GPIO step pin for the CoreXY B driver.

advanced_inputs.label: CoreXY B Dir Pin
advanced_inputs.description: Runtime GPIO direction pin for the CoreXY B driver.

advanced_inputs.label: X Min Limit Pin
advanced_inputs.description: GPIO pin for the X minimum/home limit switch.

advanced_inputs.label: X Max Limit Pin
advanced_inputs.description: GPIO pin for the X maximum limit switch.

advanced_inputs.label: Y Min Limit Pin
advanced_inputs.description: GPIO pin for the Y minimum/home limit switch at Y = 0. Probed first to establish the Y origin before X calibration runs.

firmware_requirements.protocol: Serial commands: SET XY PINS, SET XY LIMITS, CALIBRATE XY <xCm> <yCm> <speedRpm> <trapezoidFlag> <accelerationRpmPerSecond> <stepsPerRotation> <maxProbeRotations> <xCalibrationYCm> <limitBufferCm>. Firmware nudges clear of any already-pressed limit switch, homes Y-min to set Y = 0, parks at xCalibrationYCm clear of the Y switch, then probes X min and X max and records measured X steps per centimeter. The limit buffer is persisted and used by every later move.
firmware_requirements.description: Firmware routine required by the Calibrate Gantry XY block.
